situation (example wording): "What is the exact agency name for Nashville in the dataset?", "What agencies match Dallas County in Texas?", "which cities are represented in Pennsylvania?"
what the app does today: The generic line "Current Trends covers United States agencies that report monthly ... ask about a city to see if it is included." for all three.
proposed behavior: A lookup from the agency lists. An agency or county question lists the matching ORIs with name, state, type and source (Nashville: TN0190100, the Metropolitan Nashville Police Department; Dallas County: the county agency TX0570000 and every agency under county code TX057). A state question gives the agency count in the FBI's NIBRS agency list and the count with Crime Index counts, naming which is which. With no match the generic line stays.
why: Jeff 2026-11-25 via the Coordinator: replace the generic coverage line with real lookups.
status: Decided (Jeff 2026-11-25). Open: the Coordinator quoted Pennsylvania as 2,237 ORIs in NIBRS and 1,391 in the Crime Index; the fixtures hold 2,001 named PA ORIs and 1,411 PA agencies (1,376 with Crime Index counts). The NIBRS count is read from agency_year on the Runner; the Runner scorecard shows which figure the data gives.
